# 407 then CONNECT + Basic on the same TCP. 407 has Content-Length, not chunked.
C: CONNECT {{HOST}} HTTP/1.1
C: Host: {{HOST}}
C:
S: HTTP/1.1 407 Proxy Authentication Required
S: Content-Length: *
S: Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
S: Date: *
S: Proxy-Authenticate: Basic realm="labmitm-proxy"
S:
S: proxy authentication required
C: CONNECT {{HOST}} HTTP/1.1
C: Host: {{HOST}}
C: Proxy-Authorization: Basic {{BASIC}}
C:
S: HTTP/1.1 200 Connection Established
S:
